csrfHeader.name: X-Fiboki-CSRF

info.description:
Every numeric field in every response carries a Provenance. There is no endpoint that can enable live execution.

**Authentication.** A session is an httpOnly cookie issued by `POST /api/auth/login` (`sessionCookie`). Every mutating request additionally needs the double-submit CSRF header (`csrfHeader`, equal to the readable `fiboki_csrf` cookie) and an `Origin` (or `Referer`) on the deployment's exact allow-list. `x-fiboki-auth` on each operation states the requirement: `public` (no session), `session` (any signed-in role), `operator` or `admin` (role plus CSRF plus Origin); login is `origin` (allow-listed Origin, no session) and logout `csrf`. `GET /api/stream` is `session`; it also refuses a present Origin/Referer that is not allow-listed. Nothing here reads a credential from a URL.
info.title: Fiboki V2 API

post.description:
An alert at ``price``; the platform decides cross-above or cross-below.

The direction is read against the latest CLOSED bar in the store: above
that close, the alert waits for a cross above; below it, a cross below. A
level equal to the close is refused (no direction can be decided).
